profile.summary: mkxml is a mid-level JavaScript developer specializing in frontend frameworks like Preact, with strong expertise in legacy browser compatibility (particularly IE), test automation, and CI/CD pipelines. Their contributions focus on pragmatic optimizations—such as bundle size reduction, test coverage reporting, and cross-browser debugging—demonstrating a deep understanding of frontend reliability and performance. The developer excels in tooling configuration (Travis CI, Sauce Labs, Coveralls) and code quality practices (ESLint, EditorConfig), with a clear preference for frontend-focused JavaScript ecosystems.
